patch_description: The current ansatz uses two separate ZZ parameters (zz_even, zz_odd) for the two halves of the entangling ring, giving 4 unique parameters per block (24 total circuit params). The first seed variant, which used a single shared ZZ parameter for the full ring (all edges sharing one angle) plus CZ fixed couplers, achieved the same perfect accuracy with substantially fewer parameters (20 total) and better parameter efficiency (0.05 vs 0.04) and faster convergence. This suggests the extra zz_even/zz_odd split does not add useful expressivity for this task. I merge zz_even and zz_odd into a single shared "zz_ring" parameter, cutting circuit parameters per block from 4 to 3 (18 total, plus 2 readout = 20), which should improve parameter economy and convergence speed while preserving the ring connectivity and full entangling power (since the two-qubit gate itself still varies angle per training step, just tied together).
